text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
M-Mountain climbing was fun, wasn't it? 
T-The weather was nice, too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice was worried that it might start 
raining because of her... but I'm so 
relieved...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for inviting me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Coffee at the mountain peak... Even though 
it was instant, it was... strangely 
delicious...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It was most likely related to dehydration 
from sweating during the climb, combined 
with the drop in temperature at the 
summit.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps—the situation of "being 
together with a close friend" might have 
played a role.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Friends......... Um... I have a favor to 
ask of the two of you..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There was a fork in the path ahead of this 
suspension bridge. I will... head to the 
left, so you two go to the right...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? I-I'm sorry! Did Rice do something 
wrong...? Did I make you feel bad...!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No... it's not like that...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I accidentally made eye contact 
with it at the mountain peak. And now, a 
rather unpleasant "thing" is following 
us...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It might be... dangerous. Please, you two, 
head home by a different path...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-You mean a decoy...? In that case, Rice 
will do it. Because it's probably Rice's 
fault that the bad "thing" found us...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If Rice stays alone, "That Thing" will 
come after Rice... So please, leave Rice 
behind and run away together...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please calm down, Rice-san. Cafe-san, just 
how dangerous is this invisible "thing"?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Do you not... believe me?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No. I do not define what is within my 
visible range as everything that exists in 
the world.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What I want to debate is whether there 
really is a need to split into two groups. 
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With the leg strength of the three of us, 
I believe we might just be able to sprint 
through without being overtaken by "it."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... I... I'm finally 
back...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... Looks like 'that thing' 
couldn't keep up with our top speed..."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Arrival at the academy. Status check: 
before curfew. No injuries, and "everyone 
returning together" has been achieved.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the 'Friendly Outing' 
mission is complete. Good work, everyone.
